## Summary

What changes, and why?

## Related issue / RFC

Link any issue, accepted decision, or draft RFC. For new architecture, see [the RFC process](https://github.com/Ravenmoray/universal-operating-environment/blob/main/docs/rfcs/README.md).

## Evidence and validation

Describe tests, observed results, unsupported claims, and known limitations. Say clearly when tests were **not** run.

## Risk and compatibility

Consider security, new privileges, third-party licenses, reproducibility, rollback, and platform-specific assumptions.

## AI assistance / provenance

If substantial portions were AI-assisted, describe what was generated and how the submitter verified it. State any external code/data sources and rights to include them.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant documents and design decisions were read
- [ ] The change does not grant AI agents unreviewed privileged authority
- [ ] I documented observed facts separately from hypotheses
- [ ] Tests, docs, or reproducible evidence were updated where appropriate
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unlicensed binary assets are included
- [ ] Any architectural RFC status remains **Draft** until explicitly decided by maintainers

> A PR can contain a draft RFC. Merging it into the repository does **not** imply acceptance.
